text:
Most visitors sleep in Namba.
Two neighbourhoods show where Osaka actually lives 👇

📍 Tenma
One stop from Osaka Station on the Loop Line.
A 2.6 km covered shopping street.
Tiny lantern-lit izakaya just north of JR Tenma.

📍 Tsuruhashi
Osaka's Korean neighbourhood.
Yakiniku the moment you leave the station.
Kintetsu trains to Nara stop here.

✅ Our take
First trip of 2–3 nights? Stay central.
Four nights or a food trip? Try these two.
